notes.title: Patch Notes [v1.0.2] - Bugfixes
notes.content:
Hi there,

I was notified of some more annoying bugs that should now be fixed.

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] When trying to light a candle while holding the lantern, the candle and the used match would simply disappear
[*] One of the rooms sometimes wouldn't load in correctly, until the player would be inside it
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the maximum brightness in the settings - if you already changed your brightness settings, you might have to change them again, to match the brightness you had before.
[/list]

notes.title: The Disappearance of the Mitchells is now released - and off 15%!
notes.content:
Hi there!

The Disappearance of the Mitchells was just released and can now be bought for $9.99 USD.

[b]For the first week you can get it discounted to $8.49 USD, so if you want to get it cheap - get it now!
[/b]

I hope you enjoy the game as much as I enjoyed making it.

notes.title: Patch Notes [v1.0.1] - Bugfixes and Performance Increases
notes.content:
Hi there,

I was notified of some annoying bugs that should now be fixed.

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Candles can sometimes not be lit after getting clicked on without matches first. 
[*] Interaction with one of the objects didn't work correctly sometimes 
[*] Dropped objects could fall into doorframes and disappear from sight 
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Renamed "Simplified Interactions" to "Single Click Open/Close" to make it more clear, what that option does. 
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Perfomance Improvements (On my machine ~100% faster)
[/list]
